propositions: Bedrock operations fail with 'no AWS region could be resolved' when only AWS_REGION is exported, despite it being the standard region variable in modern AWS tooling.
Current region resolution order ignores AWS_REGION entirely: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION -> AWS_DEFAULT_REGION -> profile config, bypassing the standard env var that operators commonly set.

resolve_bedrock_region pure function chains three sources (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION) and returns both region and source label for explicit boto3 session configuration.
Provenance records now include region and region_source fields for bedrock provider runs when rebar's resolution chain succeeds, absent when profile-based resolution applies.
Empty-string environment values are treated as unset (botocore parity); no invented default region is applied when none in the chain resolves.
